verified_facts.text: Marquis Los Cabos is an adults' resort: all guests must be above 18 to check in.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is an adults-only property. All guests must be above eighteen (18) years old to check-in

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on the Touristic Corridor, a 15-minute drive from downtown San Jose del Cabo and a 20-minute drive from downtown Cabo San Lucas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marquis Los Cabos' prime location on the Touristic Corridor offers you the best of both Cabos. We are located 15 minutes’ drive away from San Jose del Cabo downtown and 20 minutes’ drive away from Cabo San Lucas downtown.

verified_facts.text: Los Cabos Airport (SJD) is a 35-minute drive from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Los Cabos Airport (SJD) is a 35-minute drive from the resort.

verified_facts.text: All suites face the ocean, and in winter whales can often be seen in the morning.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, all our suites front face the ocean. In winter you can see lots of whales playing in the morning.

verified_facts.text: Each of the Casitas has its own plunge pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each of our twenty-five Casitas has its own Plunge Pool.

verified_facts.text: The resort has two infinity pools and one central pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: We have two Infinity Pools and one Central Pool.

verified_facts.text: The resort's beach is not swimmable because the waves are very strong; a swimmable beach is about a 7-minute walk away.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, the waves are very strong. A swimmable beach can be found approximately 7 minutes’ walk away.

verified_facts.text: Marquis Los Cabos opened on April 6, 2003; the Marquis Hotels story began with Marquis Reforma in Mexico City in 1991.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marquis Hotels begins its story in Mexico City, on August 26th, 1991, Marquis Reforma is unveiled. After some years, on April 6th, 2003, Marquis Los Cabos is unveiled.

verified_facts.text: The resort displays a private collection of works by Latin American artists, including Mexican sculptor Jorge Marin, whose signature material is bronze.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bronze is his signature element since this material makes it possible to give the anatomical details and textures the perfection of living matter.

verified_facts.text: A series of mandalas by visual artist VENA2 is displayed around the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hidden in plain sight is a series of mandalas by visual artist VENA2

verified_facts.text: Spa Marquis offers treatments including hydrotherapy circuits and treatments with Natura Bisse; spa treatments are not included in the all-inclusive plan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hydrotherapy Circuits, and exclusive treatments with Natura Bissé. Spa treatments are not included in the All-Inclusive Plan.

verified_facts.text: Day passes are not offered, to keep an intimate, relaxed atmosphere.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, Day Passes are not available as the resort wants to keep an intimate and relaxed atmosphere for all our guests.

verified_facts.text: The resort does not offer any kind of timeshare.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, the resort doesn't offer any kind of time-share so our guests can have a more relaxed and intimate vibe at the resort.

verified_facts.text: The all-inclusive plan includes premium liquor brands, 24/7 suite service, a daily refreshed minibar, Molton Brown toiletries, parking and Wi-Fi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Premium Liquor Brands, 24/7 Suite Service, Coffee Capsules for your Nespresso Machine, Turn Down Service, Minibar refreshed daily, 2 Infinity Pools & 1 Central Pool, Resort Entertainment, Parking, Molton Brown Toiletries

verified_facts.text: Guests get preferential tee times at the Cabo Real, Puerto Los Cabos and Club Campestre de San Jose golf courses.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take advantage of the preferential green tee that you can enjoy as a Marquis guest on the world-class golf courses of Cabo Real, Puerto Los Cabos, and Club Campestre de San Jose.

verified_facts.text: Bali beds along the edge of the infinity pools can be reserved as private cabanas looking over the Sea of Cortez.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Bali beds, strategically positioned along the edge of the infinity pools, offer the perfect setting to admire the Sea of Cortez from a place of absolute comfort and privacy.

verified_facts.text: Fridays bring a Mexican Night with live mariachi and a Mexican buffet at the Central Pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience tradition with our Mexican Show, featuring live mariachi, contests, and a Mexican buffet.

verified_facts.text: Thursdays feature a live rock band and a fire show by the Central Pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Feel the energy of a live rock band and an impressive fire show, both by the Central Pool

verified_facts.text: Sunset private dining is a candlelit four-course dinner for two paired with a bottle of Louis Roederer champagne.
verified_facts.excerpt: Delight your palate with a candlelight four-course dinner for two, paired with a bottle of Louis Roederer champagne.

verified_facts.text: Resort activities include archery, beach volleyball, mixology lessons, tequila tastings and cooking lessons.
verified_facts.excerpt: Archery, Beach volleyball, Dance lessons, Table tennis, Aquarobics, Pool volleyball, Wine tastings, Mixology lessons, Tequila tastings, Cooking lessons, Theme nights

verified_facts.text: An outdoor court is used for both tennis and pickleball.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our versatile outdoor court is perfect for enjoying both tennis and pickleball.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes each suite has a hot tub, a furnished balcony and views of the Sea of Cortez.
verified_facts.excerpt: all come outfitted with a hot tub, a furnished balcony, and views of the Sea of Cortez

verified_facts.text: The resort holds the international Green Key sustainability certification.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are proud to hold the **international Green Key certification**

verified_facts.text: A desalination system converts seawater to meet all of the resort's hygiene water needs.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort has a system that converts saltwater for use in hygiene purposes, meeting 100% of our needs

verified_facts.text: Each summer the team works with the Sea Turtle Protection Network to protect nesting turtles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each summer, turtles born in Los Cabos return to create a nest. Our team works diligently with the Sea Turtle Protection Network staff to ensure turtle mothers and babies are always protected.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes every room at the resort is a suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: in fact, it has only suites

verified_facts.text: Dining at Canto del Mar carries an additional fee per person.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is an additional fee per person for dining in this restaurant.
